items.t: Peter Magyar meets Volodymyr Zelenskyy: Hungary and Ukraine make a fresh start after the icy relations of the Viktor Orban era
items.s: After years of frosty and hostile relations under Hungary's Kremlin-friendly former PM Viktor Orban, his successor, Peter Magyar, and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy seek to reset their countries' ties.

items.t: US authorises SpaceX to deploy one million satellites to space
items.s: The US' Federal Communications Commission is authorising SpaceX to send a million satellites for data centres in space, the agency said.

items.t: Houthi projectile hits Jazan port, no injuries reported
items.s: RIYADH — A projectile launched by the terrorist Houthi militia fell at Jazan port, causing minor damage but no civilian casualties. Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, spokesperson of the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen, stated that efforts were underway to determine the type of projectile used.

items.t: 'Top Gear is back': Gordon Ramsay announced as new host
items.s: TV chef Gordon Ramsay will lead the new presenting line-up on BBC motoring show Top Gear as it returns to screens in 2028.
